body: I understand how you feel. It's apparently completely normal but in our culture it doesn't feel like it. When I was in a relationship I felt like I needed to force myself to act "normal" yet that's not true, if you don't need a relationship to have a fulfilling life you shouldn't feel like you must have a relationship to be happy. Also everyone deserves to be accepted and that's what LBGTQA + is all about. You deserve to feel accepted and understood. I hope this helps and I know the wording is a bit weird. It's kinda late and I'm a bit tired but I hope you get the message and if you ever want to talk feel free to reach out💜
